title: Go/No-Go Matrix & Resource Heatmap
summary: Working spreadsheet to unify launch decision criteria (go/no-go), operational KPIs across the runway, and a compact resource heatmap showing team allocation for the final six weeks before ship. Purpose is to give execs + ops a single pane for decision calls and to surface single-point risks and contingency plans.
purpose: Consolidate objective criteria and resource constraints so Product Ops can run a clear go/no-go call and, if needed, execute pre-approved mitigations without ad-hoc escalations.
phases: Phase B: Ramp & Ops Freeze (T-20 to T-7)
Phase C: Launch Window (T-6 to T+7)
Phase D: Post-launch Monitoring (T+8 to T+30)
kpi_rows: API P95 latency (ms); <150; Priya Nair; daily; 162; yellow
Token cost per 1k gen tokens (USD); <0.60; Liam Porter; weekly; 0.54; green
Error rate (5xx + timeouts) %; <0.5%; Sana Rahman; hourly; 0.9; red
End-to-end SLA (availability) %; >99.7%; Marta Gomez; daily; 99.82; green
On-call mean time to acknowledge (minutes); <15; Ethan Park; hourly; 9; green
Regression score on core prompts (A/B eval delta); <=1.5pt; Priya Nair; weekly; 2.1; yellow
Embedding throughput (reqs/sec) baseline; >=1200; Infrastructure; daily; 980; red
go_no_go_criteria: Criterion: Production error rate <= 0.5% — Threshold: pass — Status: FAIL — Evidence: hourly-error-dash.appspot.com / PRODOPS-481
Criterion: P95 latency <= 150ms — Threshold: pass — Status: BORDERLINE — Evidence: perf-run-2025-02-11.csv
Criterion: Canary traffic success rate >= 99% over 24h — Threshold: pass — Status: PASS — Evidence: canary-monitoring/2025-02-09
Criterion: Rollback tested and automated — Threshold: pass — Status: PASS — Evidence: github.com/redwood-inference/ops/actions/rollback-workflow
Criterion: Dedicated capacity for enterprise commitments validated — Threshold: pass — Status: PASS — Evidence: contract-checklist/enterprise-capacity.pdf
contingency_plans: If error rate spikes above 1% => immediate partial rollback to last-green model; Owner: SRE (Ethan Park); pre-approved runbook: rollback-v2.json
If P95 exceeds 220ms => throttle non-critical async paths and enable lower-cost model variant for non-enterprise tenants; Owner: Eng - Serving Runtime (Liam Porter)
If embedding throughput < 800 reqs/sec => shift inference routing to Dedicated pool and increase autoscale target for dedicated; Owner: Infra (Marta Gomez)
If regression score delta > 3 pts => abort rollout and run hotfix branch evaluation; Owner: Applied ML (Sana Rahman)
prelaunch_checklist: Full runbook smoke test executed end-to-end by SRE
Billing and quota alerts configured and verified
Customer communication draft for enterprise customers reviewed
Docsite: API change notes and migration guide published
Rollout policy (canary % and timed ramp) approved in Console
Emergency contacts and escalation matrix synced to on-call schedule
Post-launch monitoring dashboard and retention set up (30d)
notes: Open question: Acceptable latency tradeoff for async fallback — decision pending from product committee (meeting 2025-02-14)
Reference: capacity model in repo: ops/capacity/simulations/2025-01
This sheet should be snapshot in the pre-launch call and archived as PDF into Confluence page after go/no-go
Next review cadence: daily standup sync for remaining 10 business days pre-ship
